name: Webform REST
description: Allows retrieving webform elements and submitting webforms via REST

suggests.drupal/restui: Optional UI to enable/configure REST resources without editing config

consumes_plugin_types: rest RestResource (@RestResource) — ships 5 REST resource plugins: webform_rest_elements, webform_rest_fields, webform_rest_submit, webform_rest_submission, webform_rest_complete_submission (each enabled by creating a rest_resource_config entity)
